name: Fouga CM.170 Magister
summary: French two-engine jet trainer famous for its V-shaped butterfly tail; used by the Patrouille de France and exported widely, a few fly in private hands in the US.

wings: Straight, mid-set wing with large permanent tip tanks
engines: Two small turbojets buried in the fuselage side by side
Small intakes at the wing roots
fuselage: Short, stubby fuselage with a long tandem canopy
Twin engine nozzles under the tail
tail: V-tail (butterfly) with two angled surfaces and no vertical fin

tellTales: V-shaped butterfly tail with no vertical fin
Straight wings with tip tanks on a small two-engine jet
Short stubby fuselage with a long tandem canopy

confusedWith.howToTell: The L-29 has a conventional tail and one tailpipe; the Magister has a V-tail and twin nozzles.
The Strikemaster has side-by-side seats and a conventional tail; the Magister has tandem seats and a V-tail.
The T-33 has a conventional tail and a long slim nose; the Magister has a V-tail.
The Iskra has a conventional tail and a single engine; the Magister has a V-tail.
